data.title: docket init should generate Claude Code skill templates
data.body:
## Goal

When `docket init` runs, it should create template versions of the `/docket:implement` and `/docket:describe` skills in `.claude/commands/` so users can customize them.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Create `templates/docket:implement.md` in the docket repo
- [ ] Create `templates/docket:describe.md` in the docket repo
- [ ] Update `init.rs` to use `include_str!` to embed templates
- [ ] `docket init` creates `.claude/commands/` directory
- [ ] `docket init` writes both skill files (if they don't exist)
- [ ] Existing skill files are not overwritten

## Context

Users need these skills in their own repositories to use docket effectively. Having `init` create them makes setup easier. Templates use `docket` command instead of `cargo run --`.
